shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' /home/user/workspace/.agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "toggl-cli entry invoice invoice-monthly billable month date range" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/arguments.rs && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/main.rs && printf '\\n--- commands mod ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/commands/mod.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' src/api/models.rs && printf '\\n--- models ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' src/models.rs && printf '\\n--- api trait/client ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/api/mod.rs && sed -n '1,300p' src/api/client.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --all --oneline --decorate -20; rg -n \"EntryAction::|ReportAction::|Command::Entry\" src/main.rs src/arguments.rs; sed -n '230,420p' src/main.rs; rg -n \"fn get_time_entries_filtered\" src/api/client.rs; sed -n '560,700p' src/api/client.rs; sed -n '1,100p' Cargo.toml"
/bin/bash -lc "git branch -a; git log --all --oneline -- src/commands | head -40; rg -n \"TimeEntry \\{\" src/commands src | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' src/commands/mod.rs; sed -n '120,155p' src/main.rs; sed -n '190,250p' src/main.rs; sed -n '800,840p' src/arguments.rs"
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-monthly-invoice.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice aggregation uses entry billing before grouping

Monthly invoice totals should filter to stopped billable entries, apply the established 15-minute rounding and 30-minute per-entry minimum independently, then group the billed seconds by each entry's UTC start month. A sorted map provides stable oldest-first output and naturally supports an empty result.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'

/bin/bash -lc "mempal search \"toggl-cli invoice-monthly JSON months total_billable_seconds\" --json --top-k 5 && sed -n '130,190p' src/arguments.rs && sed -n '1,180p' src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs && sed -n '245,270p' src/main.rs"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-monthly-invoice-json.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice JSON mirrors sorted human aggregation

The monthly invoice command exposes an explicit JSON object with "'`months` and `total_billable_seconds`; each month contains `month` and integer `billable_seconds`. The same sorted month aggregation feeds human and JSON output, including an empty zero-total schema.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals
git diff --check && git status --short'
